methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Replaces the visible label.

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name. Empty renders a decorative ring that assistive technology skips — correct whenever a nearby element already announces the wait.

options.name: showLabel
options.description: Whether the label is also drawn beside the ring.

options.name: kind
options.description: Ring colour: the accent token, or `currentColor` so the ring inherits the colour of the button or badge it sits in.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Split axis. `horizontal` puts the panes side by side behind a vertical divider; `vertical` stacks them behind a horizontal one.

options.name: size
options.description: Initial size of the START pane. A number is pixels, a string is any CSS length the browser understands; `%` resolves against the container.

options.name: min
options.description: Smallest the start pane may become, in pixels.

options.name: max
options.description: Largest the start pane may become, in pixels; null means "as large as the container allows".

options.name: collapsible
options.description: Which pane Enter/Space on the divider hides.

options.name: collapsed
options.description: Whether a pane starts collapsed; `true` uses the `collapsible` pane.

options.name: snap
options.description: Snap radius in pixels. A drag that ends within this distance of the initial size, the minimum, or the maximum lands exactly on it. `0` disables snapping.

options.name: storageKey
options.description: Key under which the size is remembered between visits. Storage failures degrade to memory rather than throwing.

methods.name: getRatio
methods.description: Returns the start pane's share of the container, between 0 and 1.

methods.name: setStart
methods.description: Replaces the start pane's content.

methods.name: setEnd
methods.description: Replaces the end pane's content.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Folds one pane away, keeping the remembered size for `expand()`. Works whatever `collapsible` says — that option only governs the keyboard affordance.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Restores a collapsed pane to the size it had.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Allows resizing again and puts the divider back in the tab order.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Blocks pointer and keyboard resizing and takes the divider out of the tab order. Any drag in flight ends immediately.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Reports whether resizing is blocked.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Disconnects the observer, drops listeners, and restores an enhanced target's original content.

options.name: gap
options.description: Space between children. A number 1–8 picks the matching `--zx-space-*` step; a string is used as-is.

options.name: inline
options.description: Whether the stack is laid out inline.

options.name: active
options.description: Initially active step name; defaults to the first enabled step.

options.name: orientation
options.description: `horizontal` lays the rail out above the stage, `vertical` puts it beside the stage.

options.name: clickable
options.description: Which steps are activated by a click: `completed` (go back only), `all`, or `false` for a display-only rail.

options.name: showNumbers
options.description: Whether upcoming and active markers show their number.

options.name: counter
options.description: Whether to render a "Step 2 of 4" line above the rail.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Activates a step unless its `change` event is vetoed. Disabled steps are ignored.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Activates the next enabled step, marking the current one complete. Does nothing on the last enabled step.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Activates the previous enabled step. Going back never clears completion flags.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns the active step name.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the zero-based active index.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Marks a step complete.

methods.name: uncomplete
methods.description: Clears a step's completion flag.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Flags or clears a step's error state. An errored step renders a warning marker and keeps its completion flag, so a wizard can still send the user back to fix it.

methods.name: setDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a step. Disabling the active step leaves it active — the user is still standing on it — but `next()`, `previous()`, and `goTo()` will skip or refuse it afterwards.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the rail's state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Aborts listeners and restores an enhanced target to the markup it had before the takeover.

options.name: active
options.description: Initially active tab name, or the first enabled tab.

options.name: variant
options.description: `divided` sets flat blocks on a muted track above a bordered panel; `bracket` outlines folder tabs that fuse into that panel; `line` underlines the active tab across a full-width rule; `segmented` renders a compact group that reads as one control, for a toolbar or card header.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Activates an enabled tab unless its change event is vetoed.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Alias of `openTab()`.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns the active tab name.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Changes a tab title.

methods.name: setBadge
methods.description: Sets or clears a tab badge.

methods.name: enableTab
methods.description: Enables a tab.

methods.name: disableTab
methods.description: Disables a tab, moving selection when it is active.

options.name: stickyHeader
options.description: Whether column headers stick while scrolling.

options.name: growing
options.description: Number of rows to render at first, with a control that appends the next batch on demand. A result set an ERP query returns happily — tens of thousands of rows — costs more to lay out than anyone will ever scroll through.

options.name: responsive
options.description: Width below which each row stacks into a card of label/value pairs instead of scrolling sideways. Measured on the table's own container, not the viewport, so a table inside a split pane stacks when *it* is narrow.

options.name: height
options.description: Scroll-region height in pixels or CSS units.

options.name: emptyText
options.description: What to show when there are no rows; null resolves `table.empty`. A Node — an `emptyState()` with an action in it, say — is placed as given, and a function is called on each render, which is what to use when the placeholder holds live controls.

options.name: zebra
options.description: Whether alternate rows use the zebra background.

options.name: editMode
options.description: Inline editing mode. `'cell'` edits one cell, `'row'` opens every editable cell of the row together and commits them as a unit. Editing is completely inert while this is `false`.

events.name: stackedchange
events.description: Fired when the table crosses its `responsive` width in either direction.

events.name: grow
events.description: Fired after more rows are rendered.

events.name: editcommit
events.payload: {row, id, column, columnId, value, previous, changes}

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Replaces all rows.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Appends rows to the current data.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Replaces the row identified by its current id.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes the row with the given id.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns a row by id.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Removes all rows.

methods.name: setSort
methods.description: Activates a column sort. Local mode stably reorders data; server mode only updates the header state and emits the request event.

methods.name: setSelection
methods.description: Replaces selected ids, ignoring ids absent from the current data.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears all selected rows.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Opens the editor for a cell. No-op unless the table runs with `editMode` and the column resolves to an editable type for that row. In `'row'` mode every editable cell of the row is opened and `columnId` only decides which editor receives focus. Any other open edit is committed first.

methods.name: growBy
methods.description: The rows currently rendered — all of them unless `growing` is on.

methods.name: showAll
methods.description: Renders every remaining row.

methods.name: getRenderedCount
methods.description: How many rows are currently rendered.

methods.name: isStacked
methods.description: Keeps the "show more" control in step with what is rendered. The control sits outside the table rather than in a `<tfoot>` row spanning every column: it is a command, not data, and a button inside the grid would be reachable by the row navigation keys as though it were a cell.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Restores an enhanced target and releases all component listeners. @returns {void}

options.name: allowCreate
options.description: Whether unknown values may be created from the query.

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Whether picking an item closes the list.

options.name: readonly
options.description: Whether tags may be added or removed.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the selected items.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Replaces the whole selection.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds one value to the selection.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes one value from the selection.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the selection.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restores the configured initial selection.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Replaces the catalogue of selectable items.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Reports whether the configured maximum is reached. @returns {boolean}

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the option list. @returns {this}

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the text input. @returns {this}

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables user interaction. @returns {this}

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables user interaction and closes the list. @returns {this}

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the read-only state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cancels pending work and restores an enhanced target. @returns {void}

options.name: step
options.description: Minute increment used by arrow keys.

options.name: clock
options.description: Offer a clock-face dial behind a toggle button.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the displayed local time.

methods.name: openClock
methods.description: Opens the clock face on the given unit.

methods.name: closeClock
methods.description: Closes the clock face. @returns {this}

methods.name: toggleClock
methods.description: Toggles the clock face. @returns {this}

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes generated content from an enhanced target. @returns {void}

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the current duration.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the timebox. @returns {this}

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the timebox. @returns {this}

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes generated content from an enhanced target. @returns {void}

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the switch state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the switch state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the configured value while on, otherwise `false`.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables user interaction.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables user interaction.

options.name: overflow
options.description: Collapses items that no longer fit into a trailing menu.

options.name: overflowLabel
options.description: Accessible name of the overflow menu trigger.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables an item.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables an item.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the pressed state of a toggle item.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes listeners, the resize observer, the overflow menu, and any DOM changes made to an adopted target.

options.name: content
options.description: Bubble content, re-evaluated on each open when a function.

options.name: placement
options.description: Preferred side; flips when it would overflow.

options.name: offset
options.description: Gap between anchor and bubble in pixels.

options.name: delay
options.description: Delay before a hover opens the tooltip, in milliseconds.

options.name: hideDelay
options.description: Delay before a leave or blur closes it, in milliseconds.

options.name: maxWidth
options.description: Maximum bubble width; a number is pixels, a string is any CSS length.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Opens the tooltip, evaluating the content first. Does nothing while disabled, already open, or when the content resolves to nothing.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Opens a closed tooltip, closes an open one.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Reports whether the bubble is currently visible.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Replaces the content. Strings are never parsed as HTML. A function is stored, not called, and runs on every subsequent open.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Allows the tooltip to open again.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Suppresses the tooltip and closes it if it is open.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Reports whether the tooltip is currently suppressed.

methods.name: getAnchor
methods.description: Returns the anchor the tooltip describes.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Closes the tooltip, removes the bubble, and puts the anchor's ARIA back as it was found.

options.name: icons
options.description: Whether to render folder and file icons.

options.name: filter
options.description: Label substring the tree is filtered by.

options.name: emptyText
options.description: Text shown when the tree is empty.

options.name: height
options.description: Scroll height in pixels or any CSS length.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the working copy of the tree, including lazily loaded children.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Looks a node up by ID.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the chain of nodes from a root down to the given node.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Filters the tree by a label substring, keeping the ancestors of every match.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands one branch, loading its children first when a lazy loader is configured.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses one branch.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Expands or collapses one branch.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expands every already-loaded branch.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Collapses every branch. @returns {this}

methods.name: reveal
methods.description: Expands every ancestor of a node so the node becomes visible.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects one node, replacing the selection in single mode.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Returns the selected node IDs.

methods.name: setSelection
methods.description: Replaces the selection.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears the selection. @returns {this}

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Returns the checked node IDs.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Replaces the checked set, propagating each ID down its sub-tree.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks or unchecks one node and its sub-tree.

methods.name: focusNode
methods.description: Moves DOM focus to a node, revealing it first.

options.name: lines
options.description: Lines to keep. One line ends in an ellipsis; more clamp the block.

options.name: title
options.description: Whether a native `title` tooltip is set — and kept up to date — while the text is actually cut off, so the full value stays reachable on hover.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Replaces all values.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Validates and appends one value.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes the first matching value.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the value input.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables editing.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables editing, removal, and reordering.
